title: Doge Bonk
blurb: Correction, delivered by a Shiba Inu with a baseball bat and no interest in mitigating circumstances. The bonk meme built a complete legal system around one cartoon thwack: a cursed thought is expressed, the bat swings, and the offender is transferred to horny jail with no hearing scheduled. What sets this version apart is the Doge lineage, because the specific dog matters to people who were online at the time. Play it when somebody posts something unhinged, says the quiet part loudly, or requires immediate redirection. The swing is both punishment and punchline.
origin: From the Doge/Cheems 'bonk' meme, the corrective bat of the internet.
